notes.title: Version 1.12 now out - details + summary!
notes.notes:
🔪🩸Greetings, fellow extreme horror enthusiasts! 😱

It's been a few thrilling days since Gore Doctor made its debut on Steam, and I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude for your invaluable feedback and unwavering support! Your comments and suggestions have been instrumental in refining the game and addressing various issues. With each passing day, I've been hard at work pushing out updates to enhance the game's polish and overall experience. 🎮👻

Today, I'm excited to announce the release of version 1.12, which brings a slew of minor improvements and fixes. Here's what's new:


 Enhanced AI behavior on the Awakening location ensures that thugs will now pursue you even if you attempt to evade them by jumping on the bleacher seatings. 
 The Kitchen Lady fight has been fine-tuned with louder footsteps and minor adjustments to her positioning vs ground. 
 Blood decals no longer awkwardly connect to the knife of the Kitchen Lady during the intro cut-scene. 
 Various materials got improvements for a more immersive experience. 
 Added sounds to the draggable wood crates to enhance realism. 
 Fixed a small bug related to the cinema repertoire item, allowing both sides of the leaflet to be visible. 
 Plus, several other minor tweaks and changes. 


Additionally (in case you missed them), I'd like to highlight some of the key changes and fixes introduced in previous updates:


 Resolved issues where certain inventory items would disappear in specific scenarios. 
 Added helpful hints in the "Awakening" and "Sanctum of Madness" locations to guide players. 
 Fixed an issue in "Sanctum of Madness" where the old hint persisted after providing electricity to the door. 
 Introduced extra textures to enemies' clothing for added variety. 
 Implemented a pause feature when using Alt-Tab, preventing automatic scene progression after loading. 
 Adjusted the number of bullets in the pistol on the "Awakening" location for consistency. 
 Various optimization enhancements and minor bug fixes. 


At this juncture, the game should be free of any major bugs. However, if you encounter any issues worth addressing, please don't hesitate to share them in the comments section. Your feedback, along with any accompanying screenshots, is immensely valuable in ensuring a seamless gaming experience for all.ːsteamhappyː 📝🎮

Thank you once again for your unwavering support, and I sincerely hope that Gore Doctor continues to provide you with spine-tingling excitement and a much-needed respite from the daily grind. 💼👻

Happy gaming! 🎮👾
